title: Securities Law 5728-1968
pages:
Chapter A: Interpretation
1. In this Law -
"security" means certificates issued in series by a company, a cooperative society or any other corporation.
Chapter E: Prospectus
15. No offer to the public shall be made except in accordance with a prospectus whose publication the Authority has permitted.
15A. Notwithstanding section 15, an offer to the public may be made without a prospectus in the cases set out in this section.

In this Law -
"security" means certificates issued in series by a company, a cooperative society or any other corporation.
No offer to the public shall be made except in accordance with a prospectus whose publication the Authority has permitted.
Notwithstanding section 15, an offer to the public may be made without a prospectus in the cases set out in this section.
